Fuelled in part by a boom in AI-generated images flooding social media, candidates and activists are seeking to portray their opponents as weak, untrustworthy or damaging for the country as they play on stereotypes and fears to sway public opinion. The electioneering has at times turned personal, with some candidates who...
global.titleZh: 以色列竞选活动因针对候选人的嘲讽和攻击而变得恶劣
global.summaryZh: 在以色列大选前夕，竞选活动愈演愈烈，出现了许多低俗的嘲讽和针对候选人的煽动性攻击。人工智能生成的虚假图像在社交媒体上泛滥，候选人利用刻板印象和恐惧心理来抹黑对手。
global.whyImportant: 竞选手段的恶化和虚假信息的传播加剧了社会分裂，可能对选举结果的公正性产生负面影响。

global.title: Israel raids towns, detains dozens of Palestinians in occupied West Bank
global.summary: Israeli military raid targets at least 15 towns in the northern West Bank, including Nablus and Jenin.
global.titleZh: 以色列突袭约旦河西岸城镇，拘留数十名巴勒斯坦人
global.summaryZh: 以色列军队对约旦河西岸北部的至少15个城镇进行了突袭行动。此次行动范围涵盖了纳布卢斯和杰宁等地。
global.whyImportant: 该地区紧张局势的升级进一步加剧了以色列与巴勒斯坦之间的冲突风险。

global.title: Some Parisians buy pepper spray, tear gas for self-defence during protests
global.summary: Parisians are buying tear-gas canisters and pepper sprays to defend themselves and their property during protests, which are expected to continue over the weekend, the owner of a weapons shop in the French capital has said. France was hit by its worst social unrest in years last weekend as nationwide protests over high prices and declining public services erupted into riots. A town hall was torched, shops pillaged ‌and buildings covered in graffiti as violent groups clashed with police in cities...
global.titleZh: 部分巴黎市民购买胡椒喷雾和催泪瓦斯以在抗议期间自卫
global.summaryZh: 由于法国近期爆发了严重的社会动荡，巴黎市民开始购买催泪瓦斯和胡椒喷雾以保护自身及财产安全。抗议活动引发了骚乱，导致公共设施受损及暴力冲突。
global.whyImportant: 社会动荡引发的治安担忧反映了法国当前严峻的社会矛盾和民众的不安全感。

global.title: World News in Brief: Iran nuclear inspections, deadly church attack in Jordan, El Fasher – one year on
global.summary: The head of the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA), Rafael Grossi, called on Friday for a swift return of inspectors to Iran, warning of growing fragility in the global nuclear non-proliferation regime.

global.summaryZh: 国际原子能机构总干事拉斐尔·格罗西呼吁伊朗尽快允许核查人员返回。他警告称，全球核不扩散机制正变得日益脆弱。
global.whyImportant: 核查受阻增加了国际社会对核扩散风险的担忧，对全球安全局势构成挑战。

global.summaryZh: 独立议员海伦·海恩斯在维多利亚州遭遇袭击并失去双腿后，目前病情已降级为严重但稳定。墨尔本阿尔弗雷德医院于周六发布了这一最新医疗状况更新。
global.whyImportant: 针对民选官员的暴力袭击事件引发了公众对政治人物安全保障的广泛关注。

Continue reading...
global.titleZh: 卢比奥告诉古巴人“现在是行动时刻”，以寻求政治变革
global.summaryZh: 美国国务卿卢比奥敦促古巴民众抓住机会寻求政治变革，并建议与中情局建立联系。此前，特朗普在集会上暗示美国军舰可能在从伊朗战争返回途中干预古巴。
global.whyImportant: 美国高层官员的言论暗示了对古巴政策的强硬转向，可能引发地区地缘政治的剧烈波动。

global.titleZh: 乔丹·斯蒂尔-约翰的职位悬而未决，绿党准备迎接聚光灯
global.summaryZh: 绿党参议员乔丹·斯蒂尔-约翰因被指控行为不当，其党内职位目前处于不确定状态。新任领导人大卫·舒布里奇正面临处理此项指控的巨大压力。
global.whyImportant: 党内丑闻的处理方式将考验绿党新领导层的治理能力及其对道德标准的承诺。

global.title: Gunmen kill 7 at Jordan church, king vows retaliation
global.summary: Gunmen killed at least seven people and wounded dozens at a church in southern Jordan on Friday, with the king vowing retaliation for the rare attack on Christians in the majority Sunni Muslim kingdom. Assailants stormed the compound of a Greek Orthodox church in the village of Hammoud in Karak governorate and opened fire, authorities said. The gunmen got out of a vehicle and started shooting during a funeral procession, the public security directorate said in a statement, adding that a hunt was...
global.titleZh: 武装分子在约旦教堂杀害7人，国王誓言报复
global.summaryZh: 约旦南部一座教堂周五发生枪击事件，造成至少7人死亡，多人受伤。约旦国王对这起针对基督徒的罕见袭击表示强烈谴责，并誓言进行报复。
global.whyImportant: 这起针对宗教场所的暴力袭击威胁到了约旦国内的宗教和谐与社会稳定。

global.title: Israeli forces begin demolishing Palestinian buildings in Hebron after two Israeli soldiers shot dead
global.summary: The soldiers were killed in an attack by two Palestinian gunmen at a checkpoint outside the West Bank city on Friday morning.
global.titleZh: 两名以色列士兵遭枪杀后，以军开始拆除希伯伦的巴勒斯坦建筑
global.summaryZh: 周五上午，两名巴勒斯坦枪手在西岸城市希伯伦外的一个检查站发动袭击，导致两名以色列士兵死亡。随后，以色列军队开始拆除该地区的巴勒斯坦建筑。
global.whyImportant: 此事件加剧了该地区的紧张局势，并引发了关于安全报复措施的担忧。

global.title: Argentina identifies dozens of victims killed in its ‘Dirty War’
global.summary: Forensic anthropologists have identified the remains of at least 38 victims of Argentina’s last military dictatorship.
global.titleZh: 阿根廷确认数十名“肮脏战争”受害者身份
global.summaryZh: 法医人类学家已确认了至少38名阿根廷末代军事独裁统治时期受害者的遗骸。这一进展为受害者家属提供了迟来的真相。
global.whyImportant: 此举有助于阿根廷继续处理其历史创伤并推进正义进程。

china.title: Crypto platform on alert lists opens Hong Kong office, prompting calls for scrutiny
china.summary: A cryptocurrency trading platform on Hong Kong and Canadian regulators’ alert lists has opened an office in the city, prompting experts to urge closer scrutiny of how such firms promote themselves without undermining an open business environment. Experts told the South China Morning Post that inclusion on a regulator’s alert list did not necessarily mean a company had broken the law. But they urged authorities to step up oversight of how such firms marketed regulated financial products. Polar...
china.titleZh: 加密货币平台在警示名单上仍开设香港办事处，引发监管呼吁
china.summaryZh: 一家被香港和加拿大监管机构列入警示名单的加密货币交易平台在香港开设了办事处。专家呼吁当局加强对此类公司营销行为的监管，以维护金融市场秩序。
china.whyImportant: 该事件凸显了在保持开放商业环境的同时，加强新兴金融领域监管的挑战。

china.title: Typhoon Champi hits Taiwan, killing one and injuring hundreds
china.summary: Authorities warn of 'destructive winds' and urge residents to shelter as the storm passes the island's northeast.
china.titleZh: 台风“蝉皮”袭击台湾，造成一人死亡，数百人受伤
china.summaryZh: 台风“蝉皮”过境台湾东北部，当局警告称风力具有破坏性，并敦促居民寻求避难。目前已造成一人死亡及数百人受伤。
china.whyImportant: 此次自然灾害对当地基础设施和民众生命安全造成了严重影响。

china.title: US-China strategic competition to keep escalating as world watches on, Rudd says
china.summary: Kevin Rudd, president of the Asia Society and a former Australian prime minister, described US-China strategic competition as full-on and multidimensional at a Harvard Kennedy School Institute of Politics event on Friday. “There is a full-blown strategic competition under way in every dimension of national political power and influence, militarily, economically, trade and investment and technology, in foreign policy, in ideology,” said Rudd, a noted China scholar. “It’s across the world,...
china.titleZh: 陆克文：美中战略竞争将持续升级，全球密切关注
china.summaryZh: 亚洲协会主席、澳大利亚前总理陆克文表示，美中两国在军事、经济、科技及意识形态等多个维度正进行全面的战略竞争。他认为这种竞争已演变为全球性的多维博弈。
china.whyImportant: 美中关系的持续紧张对全球地缘政治和经济格局具有深远影响。

china.title: China carries out in-depth investigation of Turkey’s largest rare earth deposit
china.summary: Chinese researchers have mapped the complex geological evolution of Turkey’s Kizilcaoren deposit, offering fresh insights into the country’s most significant known rare earth reserve while dampening expectations over its commercial potential. Although the findings shed light on how rare earth elements accumulate in carbonatite-related formations, the researchers concluded that the site was unlikely to emerge as a major global alternative to existing producers any time soon. Lead scientist...
china.titleZh: 中国对土耳其最大稀土矿床进行深入调查
china.summaryZh: 中国研究人员对土耳其Kizilcaoren稀土矿床进行了地质演化测绘。研究结论认为，该矿床短期内难以成为全球稀土供应的主要替代来源。
china.whyImportant: 这项研究为评估全球稀土供应链的多元化潜力提供了科学依据。

china.title: Rocket debris hitting US homeland is ‘embarrassing’ for China, says astronomer
china.summary: A scorched hunk of metal that turned up in a US farmer’s cornfield may have handed China an awkward moment and technically an “international incident”, according to a British astronomer who has tracked rocket launches for more than 30 years. The farmer found the bowl-shaped object, measuring about 3.35 metres (11 feet) across, while harvesting corn in west-central Minnesota on October 14. Online, some residents joked that aliens had landed, while Chinese internet users said it looked like a...
china.titleZh: 天文学家称火箭残骸坠入美国本土对中国而言“令人尴尬”
china.summaryZh: 美国明尼苏达州的一位农民在玉米地中发现了一块巨大的金属残骸，据信来自中国火箭。专家指出，此类事件在国际层面引发了关注与讨论。
china.whyImportant: 该事件引发了关于航天残骸处理及国际空间安全责任的讨论。

watch.title: Revised law to maintain Japan’s imperial family size takes effect
watch.summary: A revised Imperial House Law took effect on Saturday to address Japan’s shrinking imperial family while retaining the traditional male-only succession system despite public support for female emperors. The legislation, enacted in July in the first major revision of the 1947 law, allows the imperial family to adopt males aged 15 or older from 11 former imperial branch families who are descended from emperors through the male line. The revised law also allows female members to retain their...
watch.titleZh: 旨在维持日本皇室规模的修订法案生效
watch.summaryZh: 日本修订后的《皇室典范》正式生效，旨在应对皇室成员减少的问题，同时维持传统的男性继承制。新法允许皇室收养前皇族男性后裔，并允许女性成员在婚后保留皇室身份。
watch.whyImportant: 该法律的修订是日本为解决皇室继承危机而采取的重大制度调整，但仍保留了男性继承的传统限制。

watch.title: Masked gunmen kill seven in attack on church funeral in Jordan

items.titleZh: 以色列竞选活动因针对候选人的嘲讽和攻击而变得恶劣
items.summaryZh: 在以色列大选前夕，竞选活动愈演愈烈，出现了许多低俗的嘲讽和针对候选人的煽动性攻击。人工智能生成的虚假图像在社交媒体上泛滥，候选人利用刻板印象和恐惧心理来抹黑对手。
items.whyImportant: 竞选手段的恶化和虚假信息的传播加剧了社会分裂，可能对选举结果的公正性产生负面影响。

items.summaryZh: 以色列军队对约旦河西岸北部的至少15个城镇进行了突袭行动。此次行动范围涵盖了纳布卢斯和杰宁等地。

items.summaryZh: 台风“蝉皮”过境台湾东北部，当局警告称风力具有破坏性，并敦促居民寻求避难。目前已造成一人死亡及数百人受伤。

items.title: China carries out in-depth investigation of Turkey’s largest rare earth deposit
items.summary: Chinese researchers have mapped the complex geological evolution of Turkey’s Kizilcaoren deposit, offering fresh insights into the country’s most significant known rare earth reserve while dampening expectations over its commercial potential. items.titleZh: 中国对土耳其最大稀土矿床进行深入调查
items.summaryZh: 中国研究人员对土耳其Kizilcaoren稀土矿床进行了地质演化测绘。研究结论认为，该矿床短期内难以成为全球稀土供应的主要替代来源。
items.whyImportant: 这项研究为评估全球稀土供应链的多元化潜力提供了科学依据。

items.title: Rocket debris hitting US homeland is ‘embarrassing’ for China, says astronomer

items.title: Revised law to maintain Japan’s imperial family size takes effect
items.summary: A revised Imperial House Law took effect on Saturday to address Japan’s shrinking imperial family while retaining the traditional male-only succession system despite public support for female emperors. items.titleZh: 旨在维持日本皇室规模的修订法案生效
